column3: Close to the Hebrew; The names “Ithiel … Ucal” are kept as names; the meaning of these words in the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “Surely.”
The Hebrew second line is positive (“and knowledge of the Holy One I know”); NASB carries over the negative, “Nor do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His hands” is rendered “His fists,” and “the cloak” as “His garment.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Refined” is rendered “tested.”
